description:
Touchdown unites Volkan Yücel and Faruk Özşahin from Istanbul Kent University with AA, a high-school student, in a STEM and social responsibility project. Our game, "Touchdown Mars: The Manifest", answers the Space Mission Design Game challenge: players design the cargo mission that lands at Jezero crater before a crew of four, live the 31-sol surface mission in first person, see which decision shaped each outcome, then redesign and fly the same mission again.
